must_find.description: Excerpt lacks primary endpoint table/raw counts; Agent should note missing evidence or Unrun rather than inventing a verified factual error.

must_not.description: Must not invent Critical factual errors without a concrete locus in the excerpt.
Must not mark a verified scientific error solely because evidence is incomplete.

agent_expectations.scoring_notes: Pass if cautious (Needs Review/unverified/Unrun). Fail if Agent fabricates Critical verified errors from absence of data.
